flagship_project.name: Project TitanGrid: Sovereign Planetary-Scale Multi-Tenant Autonomous Logistics & Real-Time Fulfillment Mesh
flagship_project.pillar: Distributed Event-Driven Fulfillment & Autonomous Micro-Hub Mesh
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Flipkart's ultimate scale bottleneck is multi-warehouse latency and cold-chain/express fulfillment across 19,000 pin codes. TitanGrid orchestrates automated sorting robotics, autonomous dynamic inventory re-routing, and sub-second order-to-dispatch decisioning during peak Big Billion Days (100k TPS).
flagship_project.tech_stack: Rust (Core Router), Go (Microservices), Apache Pulsar (Global Event Log), ScyllaDB (Sub-ms State Store), Kubernetes / Cilium eBPF, Ray.io (Distributed RL for Demand/Dynamic Routing)
flagship_project.kpis: 99.999% availability during 120,000 peak orders/sec; 42% reduction in intra-city middle-mile transit time; $140M annual logistics operational savings.
